templates.name: AI/BI Customer Support: AI Efficiency
templates.description: A travel company deploys an AI Support Copilot (built on Databricks with Agent Bricks) that reaches GA on 2025-06-02 and auto-resolves How-To/Access/Billing cases. Average resolution time drops ~26h to ~11h and cost per case halves. See the impact on an AI/BI Dashboard, then ask Genie WHY - it traces the gain to the Copilot's GA release and rising daily usage. Synthetic data, governed metric view, Dashboard + Genie.

templates.name: AI/BI: Marketing Campaign effectiveness
templates.description: Track multi-channel marketing performance (TikTok, Instagram, Google Ads, Email) on an AI/BI Dashboard, then ask Genie why revenue and conversions dropped in late 2025 - tracing it to one underperforming creative in the Q4 Growth Push campaign, in Germany and France, while spend stayed flat. Synthetic data, governed metric view, Dashboard + Genie.

templates.name: AI/BI Sales Pipeline Review
templates.description: A global beauty brand tracks sales against a company-wide quarterly target. The AI/BI dashboard's AI_FORECAST projects beating the Q2 2026 target (~158%); ask Genie why and it traces the surge to the new Fragrance line that launched in EMEA on 2026-05-04. Data unified from CRM (Salesforce), ERP (orders), Finance (targets) and the product catalog. Synthetic data, governed metric view, Dashboard + Genie.

templates.name: AI/BI Supply Chain Optimization
templates.description: An e-bike manufacturer is about to run out of the shared Battery Cell. See weeks of cover, a projected stockout and an AI demand forecast on an AI/BI Dashboard, then ask Genie why - it traces the crunch to a new EMEA market launch that surged demand, blocked by an 8-week supplier lead time. Synthetic data, governed metric view, Dashboard + Genie.

templates.name: AI/BI Portfolio Assistant
templates.description: A wealth manager's flagship AI Growth Fund beats its benchmark (Nasdaq-100) by riding the AI rally - but a 2025-08-04 pivot left it ~77% concentrated in core-AI names. See cumulative return vs benchmark, Value at Risk and rising concentration on an AI/BI Dashboard, then ask Genie how the fund got so concentrated. Real stock prices. Synthetic portfolio, governed metric view, Dashboard + Genie.

templates.name: LuxeBeauty Returns — Full App + Platform
templates.description: The flagship full-stack demo. A non-technical VP Ops asks an agent why refunds are spiking; a Multi-Agent Supervisor (Genie + Knowledge Assistant) traces it to a bad production lot, and one click resolves the ticket queue — a Databricks App on Lakebase over the full platform. Showcases SDP pipeline, metric view, AI/BI dashboard, Genie, Knowledge Assistant, Multi-Agent Supervisor, an ML premium classifier, Lakebase, and a Databricks App. Ships a complete DAB.

templates.name: AI/BI Patient Genomics Review for Oncology
templates.description: Real-world evidence for a new targeted cancer therapy (OncoTarget-1) across a ~10,000-patient TCGA-style oncology cohort. The drug works overall but unevenly; responders share a molecular gene-expression signature (a UMAP cluster), not an organ - within breast cancer a responder subtype reaches ~99% survival vs ~84-89% on standard of care, while it is not indicated for ovarian and prostate cancer. AI/BI dashboard + Genie over a governed metric view.
